description: Channels kinetic energy into a devastating melee blow that pierces heavy armor.
Slams an opponent with a reinforced riot shield to deal blunt damage and stun.
Teleports behind an enemy in a flash of dark data for a critical backstab.
Executes a 360-degree rotational strike slicing all active hostiles in the front row.
Focuses chi energy into an unarmed palm thrust that shatters cybernetic plating.
Paints a high-precision laser grid on an enemy to maximize ranged damage.
Racial Skill (Savannah): Unleashes a fierce acid-spit spray across all foes.
Racial Skill (Bengal): Pounces onto a target with razor-sharp claws born from jungle instinct.
Racial Skill (Sphynx): Emits a resonant harmonic purr that restores health to an ally.
Bypasses security doors and locked hazard chests across the dungeon.
Scans corridors silently while completely suppressing random battle triggers.
Secures the campsite and increases HP and Energy recovery during rest by 50%.
Fabricates Iron Arrows and Plasma Bolts from scavenged metal scrap.
Constructs throwable EMP charges and shrapnel canisters for frontline fighters.
Brews Health Potions and Catnip Elixirs using raw arcane data samples.
Permanently enchants weapons or armor with elemental power or defense.
